component.name: Banner
component.description: Contextual surface for global state, warnings, promos, errors, or success without blocking the main flow. Informative by default; optional inline link, CTA, or dismiss.

antiPatterns.reason: Use helper text or inline error on the field.

antiPatterns.alternative: Single highest-priority banner or action list

contentRules: Description stays to 1–2 lines when possible.
Optional title: 4–6 words max; bold when present.
Danger: single message block uses bold body weight and component danger text token (burgundy tone).
At most one primary action (CTA or inline link as secondary discovery).

rules: Layout: optional leading emoji text property, center stack (title + description + inline link), trailing dismiss or CTA.
Emoji icon is a text layer exposed through component text properties (emojiInfo, emojiWarning, emojiPromo, emojiDanger, emojiSuccess) so instances can swap the emoji without changing structure.
Background and text colors come only from component/banner/{variant} tokens.
Banner copy uses complete Figma text style Musky/Typography/Body Small 600 plus fontWeight/semibold binding.
Promo: title token component/banner/promo/title; inline link uses promo link token with underline.
Success variant: align with semantic/status/success until dedicated component/banner/success tokens exist.
Dismiss uses IconButton with accessible name such as Cerrar.

layout.behavior: Horizontal auto-layout; trailing slot shows dismiss xor CTA when configured.

accessibility.keyboardSupport: Dismiss and CTA are focusable when present; inline link is a native link.
accessibility.screenReader: Name the region from message title or message_type; do not rely on color alone.
accessibility.focusManagement: Optional dismiss does not trap focus; banner is not a dialog.

aiHints.context: Place above main content of a screen or section. Prefer one banner; reserve danger for errors or blockers.
